svg.text: Building software that fails safely — where DevOps, QA and Observability
A metaphor I keep on my desk: intercept the defect in staging and quarantine it — long before it reaches production.
// catch the defect in staging — before it ever reaches prod

g.text: bug caught in staging — prod never saw it

svg.text: Risk-Driven Development unifies the three disciplines: prioritize by risk, not by uniform coverage.

g.text: failure mode — the defect you are introducing
QA lowers occurrence — tests catch it pre-prod
observability lowers detection — know before users
RDD spends QA & observability budget where RPN is highest — instrument what hurts most.

svg.text: THE THREE FEED INTO EACH OTHER
feedback loop — postmortems refine the next cycle
